# Aufgabe 5.2a: Element und Gleichungssystem

```{julia}
using IntervalSets
using MMJMesh.Plots
using MMJMesh.Meshes
```

Netz zum Testen

## Berechnung für ein Element

### Vorbereitung

1. Netz

```{julia}
m = Mesh(0 .. 20, 4)
mplot(m) |> mconf()
```

1. Parametrisierte Funktion

```{julia}
function bsin(b)
    function f(x)
        return b * sin(x)
    end
    return f
end

f1 = bsin(1)
f2 = bsin(5)

println("f1(π/2) = ", f1(π / 2), ", f2(π/2) = ", f2(π / 2))
```

1. Element eines FE-Netzes

```{julia}
e2 = element(m, 2)
println(e2)
println(length(e2))
```

### Umsetzung

```{julia}
using Revise
includet("src/pile.jl")

m = Mesh(0 .. 20, 23)
n4 = node(m, 4)
e8 = element(m, 8)

f1 = force(18.2)
re_func = pile_re(1.8)
ke_func = pile_ke(3.2, 8.9)
s1 = spring(121.4)

display(f1(n4))
display(re_func(e8))
display(ke_func(e8))
display(s1(n4))
```

## Lineares Gleichungssystem

### Vorbereitung

1. Funktion mit zwei Rückgabewerten

```{julia}
function test(x)
    return x, x^2
end

a, b = test(2)
println("a = ", a, ", b = ", b)
```

1. Addition einer Untermatrix

    Indexvektor

```{julia}
I = [4, 1]
K = reshape(collect(1:16), 4, 4)
Ke = [100 200; 300 400]  

display(K)
display(Ke)
display(K[I, I])

K[I, I] += Ke

display(K)
```

    Assemblierungsmatrix

```{julia}
K = reshape(collect(1:16), 4, 4)
Ke = [100 200; 300 400]  
Ae = [0 0 0 1; 1 0 0 0]
K += Ae' * Ke * Ae

display(K)
```

1. Schleife über Bestandteile des FE-Netzes

```{julia}
m = Mesh(0 .. 20, 4)
for e = entities(m)
    println(e)
    println(nodeindices(e))
end
```

1. Funktion mit Bestandteilen des Netzes assoziieren

```{julia}
m = Mesh(0 .. 20, 4)

setdata!(group(m, :elements), :test, sqrt)
setdata!(node(m, 1), :test, exp)

f = data(element(m, 3), :test)
println(f(4))
f = data(node(m, 1), :test)
println(f(1))
hasdata(node(m, 2), :test)
```

### Umsetzung

```{julia}
using Revise
includet("src/fem.jl")

m = Mesh(0 .. 20, 4)
setdata!(group(m, :elements), :ke_func, pile_ke(8.1, 9.2))
setdata!(group(m, :elements), :re_func, pile_re(68))
setdata!(node(m, nnodes(m)), :ke_func, spring(66000))
setdata!(node(m, 1), :re_func, force(20000))

K, r = assemble_kr(m)
display(K)
display(r)
```

# Aufgabe 5.2b: Bohrpfahl elementweise

```{julia}
using IntervalSets
using MMJMesh.Plots
using MMJMesh.Meshes
using MMJMesh.Mathematics
using CairoMakie: Figure, Axis, scatterlines, scatterlines!
```

## Problemparameter

```{julia}
# Basiswerte
E = 35e9
d = 0.8
l = 20
F = 2e6
ρ = 2500
g = 9.81
S = 120e6
c = 1.75e7

# Abgeleitete Werte
Ω = 0 .. l
C = c * π * d
A = π * d^2 / 4
EA = E * A
n = ρ * g * A;
```

## Exakte Lösung

```{julia}
x = parameter(Ω)
λ = sqrt(C / EA)
D = EA * λ * sinh(λ * l) + S * cosh(λ * l)

u = n / C * (1 - S * cosh(λ * x) / D) +
    F / (EA * λ * D) * (EA * λ * cosh(λ * (l - x)) + S * sinh(λ * (l - x)))

N = EA * u'

null = 0 * x

fig = Figure()
fplot!(Axis(fig[1, 1], title="Verschiebung u"), u, null, npoints=100)
fplot!(Axis(fig[2, 1], title="Normalkraft N"), N, null, npoints=100)
fig
```

## Numerische Lösung

```{julia}
using Revise
includet("src/fem.jl")
includet("src/pile.jl")
```

### Ein Netz

```{julia}
m = Mesh(0 .. 20, 40)
setdata!(group(m, :elements), :ke_func, pile_ke(EA, C))
setdata!(group(m, :elements), :re_func, pile_re(n))
setdata!(node(m, nnodes(m)), :ke_func, spring(S))
setdata!(node(m, 1), :re_func, force(F))
K, r = assemble_kr(m)
u_hat = K \ r

mplot(m, u_hat, nodesvisible=false) |> mconf()
```

### Konvergenz

```{julia}
function pile_fem(k)
    m = Mesh(Ω, k)
    setdata!(group(m, :elements), :ke_func, pile_ke(EA, C))
    setdata!(group(m, :elements), :re_func, pile_re(n))
    setdata!(node(m, nnodes(m)), :ke_func, spring(S))
    setdata!(node(m, 1), :re_func, force(F))
    K, r = assemble_kr(m)
    u_hat = K \ r
    uh = sum(u_hat .* hatfunctions(range(Ω, k + 1)))
    return uh
end

uh = pile_fem(3)
fplot(uh, u, npoints=100)
```

```{julia}
Nh = EA * uh'
fplot(Nh, N, npoints=100)
```

```{julia}
fplot(0 * x, u - uh, npoints=100)
```

## Konvergenz

Fehlerfunktion

```{julia}
fig = Figure()
Axis(fig[1, 1])
for k = 2 .^ (1:5)
    uh = pile_fem(k)
    fplot!(u - uh, npoints=100)
end
fig
```

Normalkraft

```{julia}
fig = Figure()
Axis(fig[1, 1])
fplot!(N)
for k = 2 .^ (1:5)
    uh = pile_fem(k)
    Nh = EA * uh'
    fplot!(Nh, connect_jumps=true)
end
fig
```

Fehler in der Energienorm

```{julia}
nn = 12
hks = zeros(nn)
eks = zeros(nn)

energynorm(v) = sqrt(integrate(EA * v' * v' + C * v * v, Ω) + S * v(l)^2)

for i in 1:nn
    k = 2^i
    uh = pile_fem(k)
    hks[i] = l / k
    eks[i] = 100 * energynorm(u - uh) / energynorm(u)
end
```

```{julia}
scatterlines(hks, eks)
```

```{julia}
f = Figure()
Axis(f[1, 1], xscale=log2, yscale=log10, title="Fehler in Prozent")
scatterlines!(hks, eks)
f
```
